# Wiki Emitter

The Wiki Emitter is responsible for generating OKF-conformant Markdown files from knowledge information repository data. It manages the emission of wiki pages and updates indexes and recent change logs, ensuring that only modified content is regenerated, thus optimizing the compilation process.
